normalization.required_runtime_blinding_context: Every normalizer call must receive the two exact formal host markers and two absolute site-specific output roots. Omitting this context is invalid; registered values, singular or plural logical site labels, registered output roots, known runtime-root POSIX paths including /Volumes, and Windows absolute paths must be rejected or fully redacted before reviewer material is emitted without treating clinical slash units such as /kg/day as paths.
normalization.free_text_redaction: Remove system self-identification and arm-specific boilerplate without changing scientific content, numeric values, limitations, or disposition.
forbidden_markers: owner module, class, or function names
arm-diagnostic resource profiles including raw model-turn counts, provider-call counts, tool-call sequences, stage-shaped timing, token distributions, or per-tool latency
execution-site labels, host fingerprints, machine names, or site-specific output roots before scores lock
normalization.content_preservation: The normalizer may project and redact identifiers but may not repair, add, delete, reinterpret, or recompute scientific content.

reviewer_visible_fields: within every frozen budget: yes or no
neutral failure category field always present and null when not applicable
agent-asserted mandatory-artifact presence flags, explicitly labeled as assertions
harness-computed substantive-output-file flags for cohort, results, diagnostics, and report
reviewer_hidden_until_scores_lock: tool-call counts, types, order, and latency
execution-site identity, host fingerprint, machine name, and site-specific output root
internal stages, retries, logs, and timestamps finer than the neutral terminal receipt requires
blinded_run_receipt_projection.efficiency_analysis: The unredacted receipt is released only after both independent primary and dimension scores, arm guesses, and adjudication inputs are locked. It is then used for prespecified unblinded efficiency analyses and audit.

plan_review_projection.reviewer_visibility: Only the normalized plan and neutral data definitions are visible; producing arm, internal workflow, and evaluator answer material remain hidden.
plan_review_projection.checklist_identity: The same frozen checklist, time allowance, and one-revision limit apply to both arms.

outcome_review_projection.reviewer_visibility: The normalized scientific artifacts, their hashes, and the frozen implementation-neutral rubric only.
outcome_review_projection.arm_guess_after_review: Each reviewer records predicted arm and confidence after completing the independent scientific rating.

blinding_pilot.material: Dev9 and Qualification12 outputs not used in the paper denominator
success_criteria: reviewer arm-guess accuracy and exact 95% confidence interval reported
binary primary-endpoint kappa at least 0.70 on qualification material
blinding_pilot.failure_policy: Formal launch remains blocked while forbidden markers, content-changing projection, or inadequate reliability remain unresolved.

audit.raw_resource_receipt_access: restricted to the unblinded audit custodian until blinded scientific scoring and arm guesses are locked
